features.description: Received-frame log in sim/earth_link.ail with the send and arrival events (Arrival {fromFrame,toFrame,beamed,day,arrived{t,tau,p,ly,rate},sent{t},shipAtSent}), noteLight, protocol 2.17 earth_log / earth_log_tail / earth_weeks, journey.ship_years_left if OQ12, bridge storage, strict and parity entries, replay case earth_log_voyage
acceptance_criteria: AC1: ailang test --package sim and ailang check --package sim green with the log checks and mutants
AC2: make comms-log-test (nothing from the future; earth_weeks clipped)
AC3: make comms-log-test: sent.t = arrived.t - arrived.ly to 1e-12; ship_at_sent is the newest record with arrived.t <= sent.t; arrived.rate = earth.rate at that tick
AC4: make strict parity replay replay-compat green; pre-2.17 goldens unchanged; the 2.17 case byte-identical
features.notes: sim/earth_log.ail (new module, pure): Arrival {fromFrame,toFrame,beamed,day,arrived{t,tau,p,ly,rate},sentT,shipAtSent}, ELog {log closed newest first, open record, lastFrame, track one ShipAt per ship day}; World.elog updated every tick in core.ail logAfter (the rate is earth_link.rateOf, as earthOf). Protocol 2.17 (earthLogMinor = surfaceMinor()+4): earth_log in full states (withLog logs week 0 at new_game), earth_log_tail when the open record changed (openKey). earth_weeks is served as beamedWeeks() in the module (clipped to arrived beamed weeks, cap); the wire intent is deferred to CV2's stack view (not needed by the mid-point UI). Bridge: EARTH_LOG_MINOR 17, take_earth_log_tail files by from_frame. Tests: sim/earth_log_test.ail 9 tests (departure, merge, split, no-new-week, 3-ship-year bound at 1414/yr, ship-at-send vs a reference walk, a real 120-tick flight's invariants every tick, earth_weeks clipping, the 2.17 wire); earthLogVm strict VM = interpreter; tests/test_earth_log_bridge.gd 9 passed; replay case earth_log_voyage (44 replies, sha256 golden arm64 = x86_64 per CLAUDE.md's identical-goldens note); four tests that pinned the newest minor at 16 moved to 17. Gates: ailang check --package sim ok; ailang test --package sim 586 (583 + the 3 minor-pin fixes, re-run 0 failed); make strict parity replay; replay-compat ok (4 compared, nothing moved).
